name: abandon_project
description: Give up a project, a research effort, or another long effort.

name: advance_project
description: Add progress to a project, a research effort, or another long effort. Record in the note what the time, money, or roll bought. The project completes when progress reaches its target.

name: start_project
description: Begin a long-running effort and track its points toward a target: a project, a piece of research, or another long effort. The kind and goal are free text; the target is how many points of work it needs. Advance it with advance_project as time, money, and rolls are spent.

force.description: Set true to replace a project of the same name.

name.description: The project's name, unique among projects.

target.description: How many progress points it needs.

name: list_projects
description: List every project with its progress, notes, and whether it is complete or abandoned.
